content: The soul would possess no radiant rainbow had the eyes no tears.
author: Native American Proverbs
explanation: A rainbow requires two ingredients: brilliant sunlight and heavy rain. If you run away from sorrow, anesthetize your grief, and demand a life of shallow, unbroken amusement, your soul will remain flat and colorless. The tears of deep empathy and honest mourning refract divine beauty.
practicalInsight: Welcome the tears of honest emotion today. Trust that the sunlight of your spirit is creating a rainbow through the rain.
reflectionPrompt: What season of weeping in your past ended up deepening the colors and beauty of your soul?
